title: Hearty Irish Shrimp Chowder
description: A comforting and flavorful soup that combines the richness of Irish cuisine with the freshness of shrimp.
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add diced potatoes and sliced carrots, cook for 5 minutes.
Add chicken broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add peeled shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 5 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Mix in flour to thicken the soup, cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
